                        PROCEDURAL ORDER REGARDING PRCe360

        THIS MATTER comes before the New Mexico Public Regulation Commission

(“Commission”) upon its own motion. As discussed below, the Commission orders parties,

stakeholders, and any other filers in this proceeding to adhere to modified rules and procedures

during the Commission’s transition to a new case management system and the pendency of the

Commission’s ongoing rulemaking regarding its procedural rules.1

                                             DISCUSSION

        1.      On January 26, 2026, the Commission's new electronic case management system,

PRCe360, will go live, and the outdated eDocket system will no longer support filing submissions.

Implementing PRCe360 has the effect of immediately rendering the processes and procedures

contained in various sections of 1.2.2 NMAC, outdated and obsolete.

        2.      On January 21, 2026, to account for the transition to PRCe360, in Docket 26-

00007-UT, 2 the Commission issued an order requiring parties, stakeholders, and all other

participants in the Commission dockets to adhere to interim working rules and procedures. The

Commission indicated that the interim working rules and procedures will be in place until the

Commission concludes formal rulemaking proceedings that incorporate the updated electronic

case management system.3




1 These rules and procedures are available on the Commission’s website, at prc.nm.gov/prce360.
2 See Administrative Order Regarding PRCe360 (“Administrative Order”) (Jan. 21, 2026).
3 See Order Issuing Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (May 29, 2025).
         3.       To ensure that all stakeholders, parties, and participants in active Commission

dockets receive notice of the order to adhere to the interim working rules, the Administrative

Notice required that a procedural order be filed in every active docket, requiring compliance with

the Administrative Order and PRCe360 working rules. The Administrative Order also requires that

the link to the interim working rules and procedures be provided to stakeholders, parties, and

participants of all active Commission dockets.

                                  FINDINGS AND CONCLUSIONS

        4.       The Commission finds and concludes that it is appropriate to provide parties,

stakeholders, and any other filers in each pending proceeding before the Commission notice of the

requirements contained in the Administrative Order regarding the transition to PRCe360.

        5.       The Commission finds and concludes that parties, stakeholders, and any other filers

in this proceeding shall adhere to interim, working rules and procedures available on the

Commission’s website, prc.nm.gov/prce360, during the Commission’s transition to PRCe360 and

the pendency of the Commission’s ongoing rulemaking regarding its procedural rules.4

        6.       These rules and procedures are subject to change based on ongoing user testing and

stakeholder feedback. For notice regarding changes to these rules and procedures, filers should

monitor the Commission’s website and the Commission’s administrative docket regarding the

transition to PRCe360, Docket No. 26-00007-UT.




4 1.2.2.8(D)
              NMAC (authorizing orders “waiv[ing] the application of any procedural provision of [the
procedural] rule”); 1.2.2.24(A)(4) NMAC (authorizing orders “setting forth . . . any requirements for the filing,
service, or presentation of pleadings, discovery requests, discovery responses, testimony, exhibits, or other
documents in electronic form”); NMSA 1978, § 62-6-4(A) (authorizing the Commission “to do all things
necessary and convenient in the exercise of its power and jurisdiction”); NMSA 1978, § 62-19-9(B)(5), (10)
(authorizing “ administrative action by issuing orders not inconsistent with law to assure implementation of and
compliance with the provisions of law for which the commission is responsible and to enforce those orders by
appropriate administrative action and court proceedings”).

        IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED:

       A.       The Commission hereby ORDERS parties, stakeholders, and any other filers in this

proceeding to adhere to the interim, working rules and procedures for PRCe360 beginning on

January 26, 2026. These interim, working rules and procedures are available at

prc.nm.gov/prce360.

       B.       This Order is effective when signed.

       C.       The Commission shall serve a copy of this Order upon all persons listed on the

attached Certificate of Service via e-mail if their e-mail addresses are known, and otherwise, via

regular mail.

       D.       In computing time in accordance with statute, regulation, or Commission order, the

computation shall begin on the date that this Order is filed with the Chief Clerk of the

Commission’s Records Management Bureau or the Chief Clerk’s designee.

       SIGNED under the Seal of the Commission at Santa Fe, New Mexico, this 22nd day

of January, 2026.

                         NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION
